steps.content: [Mobile Message]

steps.speaker: Extra-Rich Apple Juice
steps.content: Have you set off yet, Ashy? Hot Toddy is online on Holy Dragon Canyon! I'll try to let him defeat me before he goes to class. You can meet him soon if you head to the internet cafe's entrance now!

steps.speaker: Extra-Rich Apple Juice
steps.content: If my deduction is correct, he usually wears black clothes and glasses and he likes to walk around in flip-flops on school days. He often stays up late playing video games, so he likely has a pale and puffy face with deep dark circles under his eyes!

steps.speaker: Extra-Rich Apple Juice
steps.content: Ahhhh, typing is such a hassle. Why don't you go live? It'll make it more immersive for me too!
But I'll keep you posted if there are any updates.

You cooperate as much as possible with <color=#fb9259>Extra-Rich Apple Juice</color> to verify the credibility of the information she provides. She hasn't noticed your suspicion and continues to offer help with great enthusiasm.

steps.speaker: Extra-Rich Apple Juice
steps.content: Alright, I'll make sure Hot Toddy_815 walks out of the internet cafe basking in the glow of victory and with his guard completely down!

steps.speaker: Extra-Rich Apple Juice
steps.content: If he doesn't show up here, I know another place!

steps.speaker: Extra-Rich Apple Juice
steps.content: I searched for Simon on other platforms and found plenty of pictures and information. I can even deduce his home address now. Look at the angle here and the street outside this window, it's probably a higher level in building 16 of the Garden complex...

options: Isn't this already an invasion of privacy...

steps.content: The virtual battle between Extra-Rich Apple Juice and Hot Toddy_815 has begun. Meanwhile, on the battlefield in real life, you wait right outside the internet cafe as planned.

12:00 p.m.
The Fifth Avenue, Eastside
The street is so crowded with pedestrians that you remain somehow inconspicuous even in your uniform among them.

steps.speaker: Passerby
steps.content: Hi, I'd like an iced latte without coffee or milk. Can I pay online?

steps.speaker: Passerby
steps.content: Sorry, I'll be there in five minutes! I overslept. Don't worry, it's not insomnia, I was just up looking at my phone.

steps.speaker: Passerby
steps.content: Interested in swimming and fitness? You seem quite tired. I bet you could use some extra muscles! Why not get a membership card now? There's a discount...

The minor disturbances you're dealing with have not hindered the busy city from operating at its own pace. Neither the Exterminator nor the missing person cases are a trending topic in Eastside. After turning down a gym flyer, you continue your watch at the target location, waiting.
Finally, at 12:20, a male around eighteen years old shows up on time.
He's wearing glasses, flip-flops, and an all-black outfit that desperately needs washing. Even the dark circles under his eyes match Applehead's description.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Excuse me, do you know <color=#fb9259>Hot Toddy_815</color> by any chance?
The man stops in his tracks. The moment your eyes meet, he quickly averts his gaze anxiously.

steps.speaker: Hot Toddy_815
steps.content: How do you know that name?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Wasn't it you who posted about me, <color=#fb9259>Simon</color>? You claimed I was the real culprit behind the disappearance cases.

steps.speaker: Simon
steps.content: You... you're that Exterminator on Gray Mirror!

It doesn't take him long to figure it out. The moment you call out his name, he realizes you've been communicating with <color=#fb9259>Extra-Rich Apple Juice</color>. He looks around warily, as if searching for any other accomplices you might have.

options: Are you scared now? You seem braver online.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I'm not here to pick on you. I just want to talk about that post on Gray Mirror, about those disappearance cases you know about...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: ...Hey!
Before you finish your sentence, he takes off running.
